title: Restore live panels and trace continuity after metrics-forwarder regression
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Summary: During two customer escalations on 2026-03-09 and 2026-03-10 we observed missing time-series in Console live panels (empty charts with 0 samples) and truncated trace spans for requests routed via Dedicated and Private gateways. Impact: multiple Hosted customers (notably Acme AI) and a Private deployment (Federated Health) reported inability to inspect real-time metrics and trace correlations during active incidents. Scope: affects metrics ingestion path from metrics-forwarder v2.14 (released 2026-03-09) which introduced an aggressive tag-filter rewrite that dropped 'slo_marker' and 'route_id' tags used by Console panels and tracing join keys. Additionally, a side-effect in the KV cache TTL for trace-join metadata caused gaps in span correlation for private agents when network hiccups occurred.

Root cause: metrics-forwarder v2.14 contained an optimization that deduplicated tags by a canonicalization step. A bug in the canonicalization logic removed tags starting with 'slo_' and truncated multi-segment 'route_id' values. This resulted in: (1) Query selectors in live dashboards returning no series; (2) Trace correlation failing to join ingress -> model -> cache lookup spans in Private because the join key was altered. A configuration change to the trace agent TTL (from 90s to 10s) during the same release exacerbated the gap during transient failures.

Work plan:
- Immediate mitigation (done): rolled back metrics-forwarder to v2.13 for Hosted and Dedicated within 2 hours of incident; reconfigured Private edge to use legacy trace-join TTL (90s). Announced mitigations to affected customers and CS.
- Backfill: launched backfill job (backfill-obs-20317) to replay missing metrics from short-term buffer for the last 36 hours; prioritized SLO markers and dashboard panels referenced in customer reports.
- Code fix: patch to canonicalization logic to preserve tags prefixed with 'slo_' and to keep route_id intact; add unit tests and a property test to ensure tag-preservation across normalization paths.
- Trace fix: revert TTL change in trace-agent and add a guard that prevents TTL < 60s for private agent configs unless explicitly approved by SRE.
- Observability: add new alerts for sudden delta in series counts per dashboard panel and an alert when trace join success rate falls below 95%.

Acceptance criteria:
- Affected dashboards render non-empty panels for last 6 hours within 30 minutes of fix deployment.
- Trace correlation end-to-end success rate >= 99% for synthetic test flows (ingress -> model -> respond) for 24h after release.
- Backfill completes with >95% of SLO-marker series restored for the 36-hour window.
- PR review completed and merged, automated regression test added to infra-ci.

Notes: Coordinate rollout with Dedicated capacity team for planned deploy windows to avoid SLA blips. Communicate postmortem with customers and include timeline of events and compensatory credits where appropriate.
